title: Reorder Launch Json by Task Kind
prompt: Reorder .vscode/launch.json configurations by task kind (BUILD, PUBLISH:TEST, PUBLISH, DEV) instead of by package name. Rename generic language debuggers (Go → Go dev, Python → Python dev). Unify semio-repo/vscode package into build.
